proposedContributions.change: Implement KnowledgeProvider as a projection over an injected host-authorized read backend, not another store. search/get/getContext/list methods return canonical page/section/collection refs and complete bounded sections; open uses an injected canonical navigation callback. Keep generic authored-knowledge mutations unsupported with typed UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION and all mutation capabilities false; explicit generation belongs to the code-intelligence job lifecycle, not knowledge read or mutation fallbacks. Do not import server-core, spawn processes or invoke models from core.

Implement the neutral RepoWiki read contract with the pinned upstream search/read/list surface; keep generation's begin/submit_plan/next_page/submit_page/finish calls in a separate explicit writer-job bridge to accepted CI-004 jobs. Strictly normalize provider selectors/heading anchors, imported pages, sidecars and run schema; return full selected heading sections or an explicit limit error. Preserve schemaVersion/runId/phase/sourceFingerprint and ordered pending/skipped/complete page jobs in the shared job checkpoint with lossless provider metadata. Compare exact captured snapshot/policy and provider-native fingerprint before resume/page submission/finish. Use only an approved leased staging namespace, never an arbitrary user-page output root. Opt out of telemetry in every provider process; no installation, auto-start or model call for local read paths.

Normalize add/confirm/update/retract claim metadata with provider-local IDs mapped through scopedProviderResourceId. Resolve evidence against authorized immutable snapshot/span refs and assign SourceVersion/contentHash/snapshotId from actual resolved bytes, never a model-proposed version. Retain current/stale/missing/retracted claim status separately from supported/partial/contradicted/unresolved semantic support. Persist the accepted shared VerificationReceipt shape with claim/ref IDs, exact snapshot, assessor, method, rationale, checkedAt and assessment; emit authorized monotonic freshness/assessed events through CI-004. No separate claim/receipt database or regex-based automatic semantic support.
